description: This file implements the QuicChromiumAlarmFactory class and the QuicChromeAlarm class, which are used to create and manage alarms within the QUIC protocol implementation in Chromium. It includes methods for setting, canceling, and firing alarms, integrating with Chromium's task runner and clock.

classes.name: QuicChromeAlarm
classes.description: A custom alarm class that integrates Chromium's timer and clock with QUIC's alarm interface.

methods.name: QuicChromiumAlarmFactory::CreateAlarm
methods.description: Creates a new QuicChromeAlarm, optionally using a provided arena.

methods.name: QuicChromiumAlarmFactory::CreateAlarm
methods.description: Creates a new QuicChromeAlarm with a delegate.

methods.name: QuicChromeAlarm::SetImpl
methods.description: Sets the alarm to fire at the specified deadline.

methods.name: QuicChromeAlarm::OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback invoked when the alarm fires; checks clock and fires the associated QUIC alarm.

methods.name: QuicChromeAlarm::NowTicks
methods.description: Returns the current time in ticks, using Chromium's clock.
